arxiv_cpcv.title: Hopfield Networks for Asset Allocation
arxiv_cpcv.why: Uses combinatorial purged cross-validation over several datasets for portfolio selection; the CPCV reference already recorded in financial-validation.md.

arxiv_walkforward.title: AlgoXpert Alpha Research Framework. A Rigorous IS WFA OOS Protocol for Mitigating Overfitting in Quantitative Strategies
arxiv_walkforward.why: An in-sample / walk-forward-analysis / out-of-sample protocol; independent 2026 validation that the deploy-order walk-forward is the overfitting control, matching walkforward.js.

arxiv_walkforward.title: The GT-Score: A Robust Objective Function for Reducing Overfitting in Data-Driven Trading Strategies
arxiv_walkforward.why: A robust objective for strategy selection; candidate framing for a promotion objective beyond pooled Sharpe/DSR.

arxiv_walkforward.title: Regime-Conditional Distributional Comparison of Trading Strategies: A GAMLSS/ZAGA Framework Applied to the S&P 500
arxiv_walkforward.why: Distributional strategy comparison conditioned on regime; a candidate extension of promoteDecision (per-regime fold conditioning).

arxiv_dsr.title: What survives honest evaluation? Leakage-safe, search-aware assessment of LLM-driven trading strategy discovery
arxiv_dsr.why: CENTRAL: a deliberately leaky oracle posting Sharpe 35 SURVIVES Deflated Sharpe and probability-of-backtest-overfitting testing. Statistical correction (DSR/PBO) is not redundant with a structural look-ahead guardrail — the empirical justification for walkforward.js auditNoLookahead.

arxiv_dsr.title: Equity Strategy Backtesting: Luck or Edge? The MinervaScore as a Statistical Robustness Grade
arxiv_dsr.why: Already recorded; a complementary robustness grade to DSR/PSR.
